pages.text: A response grows with the dose as a Hill curve, D^2/(K^2 + D^2): too little does nothing, enough saturates. An adjuvant raises the whole curve, (1 + a). Enough binding, and the body remembers.
$(thing)Set$(): Dose, Adjuvant.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Warm store: the response varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Too strong: the imprint resonates.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A strong response is faster.
